answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The ocean lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the horizon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
